task:
Add logging to this order worker so each order can be traced through the pipeline:

```python
def process(order):
    validate(order)
    charge(order)
    ship(order)
```

constraints.text: log calls use %-style lazy arguments, e.g. logger.info('charging %s', order_id), not f-strings
constraints.why: eager f-string formatting serialized full cart objects on disabled debug lines and added 30 ms per order in the 2026-04 latency hunt

constraints.text: modules log through logging.getLogger(__name__), never via the root logging.* helpers
constraints.why: a vendored library reconfigured the root logger in 2026-01 and worker logs vanished for two days
